lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Do you have any plans after work today?
lines.ko: 오늘 퇴근 후에 무슨 계획 있어요?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Not really. I was thinking about going straight home.
lines.ko: 딱히 없어요. 바로 집에 갈까 생각하고 있었어요.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'm going to try the new noodle place near the station. Would you like to come with me?
lines.ko: 저는 역 근처에 새로 생긴 국숫집에 가보려고 해요. 같이 갈래요?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure, that sounds good. What time should we meet?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Let's meet in front of the station at six thirty.
